description: Update all documentation and project metadata to reflect Phase 11 completion. Independent of FEAT-002's runtime code but should run after it to reflect final test count. Updates README.md (status, features, structure, roadmap, CLI section, test count), docs/architecture.md (Phase 11 section), and docs/setup.md (Physical Robot section with CLI usage).
steps:
Step 1 — Update docs/architecture.md: Add a '## Phase 11 — Physical Robot Support' section after the Phase 10 section and before 'Design Principles'. Include subsections:
  - Overview paragraph: hardware abstraction bridging sim to real, safety system, sim-to-real transfer utilities.
  - Hardware Abstraction Layer — forge_core/hardware.py: describe RobotInterface ABC, SimulatedRobot, RobotState/RobotCommand/RobotStatus dataclasses, run_policy_on_robot function. Include a table of RobotInterface methods.
  - Safety System — forge_core/safety.py: describe SafetyMonitor wrapping RobotInterface, SafetyConfig loaded from YAML, SafetyViolation logging. Include table of SafetyMonitor methods.
  - Sim-to-Real Transfer — forge_core/sim2real.py: describe domain randomization, trajectory comparison, calibration utilities.
  - Configuration: mention config/robot.yaml and config/safety.yaml.
  - CLI — scripts/forge_robot.py: list all subcommands with brief descriptions.
  - Integration Points: how it connects to Policy, ForgeSimulation, Recorder.
  Also update the opening paragraph and Overview to say 'Phases 1–11'.

Step 2 — Update docs/setup.md: Add a '## Physical Robot Support' section after the 'Fleet & OTA' section. Include CLI usage examples for all forge_robot.py subcommands: connect, run, safety-check, calibrate, compare-sim, status. Update the 'Running Tests' section test count to reflect the new total. Update any mention of phase count.

Step 3 — Update README.md:
  - Change status heading from 'Phase 10 — Fleet & OTA' to 'Phase 11 — All Phases Complete'.
  - Update the status paragraph to say 'Phases 1–11 are complete' and add 'physical robot support (hardware abstraction, safety system, sim-to-real transfer)' to the feature list.
  - Add 'Physical robot support' bullet to the 'What's included' list: hardware abstraction layer (RobotInterface ABC, SimulatedRobot), safety monitoring (joint/velocity/workspace limits), sim-to-real transfer (domain randomization, trajectory comparison, calibration).
  - Update 'What's NOT included' — remove 'physical robot' since we now have the software infrastructure.
  - Add Physical Robot section to Quick Start with forge_robot.py CLI examples.
  - Update Project Structure: add hardware.py, safety.py, sim2real.py to forge_core/ listing, add forge_robot.py to scripts/, add robot.yaml and safety.yaml to config/.
  - Update Phase Roadmap table: Phase 11 status to 'Done', capability 'Physical robot support'.
  - Update test count from '328 automated tests' to the actual final count.
  - Update 'Verify' section test count.
Step 4 — Run the full test suite and record the actual final test count. Update all doc references to match the real number.
acceptance_criteria: docs/architecture.md has a Phase 11 section with hardware abstraction, safety, sim-to-real subsections
docs/setup.md has a Physical Robot Support section with CLI examples
README.md status is 'Phase 11 — All Phases Complete' with updated feature list, structure, roadmap, and test count
Phase roadmap in README.md shows all 11 phases as Done
All test count references match the actual pytest output
verification: Run `python3 -m pytest tests/ -v` — all tests pass, note final count
Run `grep 'All Phases Complete' README.md` — returns a match
Run `grep 'Done.*Physical robot' README.md` — returns a match
